name: Paying A Late Tithe
overview: Scripture emphasizes the holiness and importance of tithing as an act of honoring the Lord with the firstfruits of our increase, recognizing that all belongs to Him (Leviticus 27:30; Proverbs 3:9). While the Bible commends faithful giving regardless of amount, as seen in the widow's humble offering (Mark 12:42), it also warns against performing acts of righteousness for human approval (Matthew 6:1). The principle of generous and sincere giving is affirmed with the promise that it will be returned in abundance (Luke 6:38). Though the sample verses do not directly address late tithing, they establish that tithing is a sacred commitment made before God, as Jacob's vow illustrates (Genesis 28:20), underscoring the need for timely and heartfelt obedience to this covenantal responsibility.
